## Historical audit

**Scope:** S0101, `/srv/lab-disks/disk2/users/xymo/Documents/Codex/2026-11-02/scene-rsi-rsi-1-3d-blender/outputs/scene_rsi_pilot/results/r2/generic_rsi/C2/selection/commons_133800864/trajectory.jsonl`. Only chunk 2 of 2 is available; cited offsets are character ranges within the JSONL line. The referenced images are not visible in the supplied observations.

| Evidence | Observation and interpretation |
|---|---|
| Line 19, [0,54593), student `model_request` | The stated goal was to reconstruct an indoor photograph with separate SceneAct meshes, matching camera, geometry and appearance. The final request was **selection only**, with no executions remaining, among three reported successful renders. This establishes the goal, not fidelity. |
| Line 19, [0,54593), step 3 execution report | The runner reported `ok: true` and `usable_render: true`, with a saved render and 261 scene primitives. Its inventory names multiple objects, including window and blinds, cabinets, sink, faucet, blender, pitcher and jug. Names and primitive counts support an inventory claim, not independent confirmation that objects, supports or connections are geometrically correct. |
| Line 19, [0,54593), prompt and report | Materials and texture handling, camera, lighting and render settings are discussed in the instructions; the report shows rendering completed. This excerpt does not expose the executed code or image pixels, so actual material assignment, texture appearance, pose, camera match, lighting quality and part contact cannot be verified. No render failure is reported for step 3. |
| Lines 20 [0,4306), 21 [0,349), 22 [0,59) | The fresh, read-only student session had four image inputs, no tool calls and completed normally. The student responded `SELECT 3`; the controller recorded selection of step 3. No rationale or new edit is visible. |

**Teacher and autonomy.** The visible request contains a shared reconstruction procedure and revision instructions, but no identified teacher message, teacher diagnosis, proposed teacher update, or evidence of the student receiving and adopting one. Availability of instructions is not evidence that a particular recommendation was executed. The selection session shows no autonomous tool exploration; earlier work and changes are outside this chunk.

**Outcome and uncertainty.** Formal execution and selection of step 3 succeeded. Visual or geometric correctness remains **unknown**, not independently established by the success flag or object names. The record does not support an algorithm-failure, empty-patch or technical-interruption finding for this selection. A transferable caution is to distinguish a usable render and semantic inventory from verified appearance and physical connection; the particular kitchen-object inventory and choice of step 3 are task-specific. Whether step 3 actually better matches the reference, and what changes produced it, remain unresolved.
